## New module: `text_search_parser.py`
- `TextSearchQuery` dataclass with `include`, `exclude`, `required` (all default to empty lists).

  - Splits space-separated terms into OR-logic `include` terms.
  - Routes `-`/`!`-prefixed terms to `exclude`, `+`-prefixed to `required`.
  - Ignores solo `-`, `!`, `+`.
  - Preserves original case and Unicode.
  - Parses double-quoted phrases as single terms (prefix rules still apply), handling `\"` and `\\` escapes, treating single quotes as ordinary chars, and consuming the rest of input on an unclosed quote.
